description: Modify the gPLink attribute of an OU/site to attach an attacker-controlled GPO to its scope.

telemetry.detail: gPLink attribute modification under DS-change auditing (default OFF).
A directory service object was created (new GPO link).
Linking a GPO to a privileged OU affects many machines and is a high-impact, increasingly-modelled change.

prerequisite_privilege: WriteProperty on the OU/site gPLink (or GenericWrite/GenericAll)
abuse_primitive: Link a malicious GPO to the target OU to gain execution/rights across its members.
notes: High blast radius. Also leaves SYSVOL file artifacts when the GPO payload is staged. Loud where GPO changes are monitored.
